meta.description: Final national generic-ballot polling averages vs. actual U.S. House two-party popular-vote margin, by cycle. Powers the projection's sensitivity band (projection.json meta.uncertainty). The pipeline emits NO band until every cycle row is verified:true and epsilon_points is set.
meta.epsilon_method: root-mean-square of signed misses (error_points), rounded to 0.1
meta.basis: RMS miss of final RealClearPolitics generic-ballot averages vs. the actual House two-party margin, 2016-2024
meta.actual_margin_source: Committed baselines data-pipeline/baseline/house_{year}.json: MIT Election Data and Science Lab (2016-2022); U.S. House Clerk 2024 election statistics (2024).
meta.two_party_note: Actual margins are two-party (D minus R over D plus R), the same convention the pipeline uses for baseline_2024_margin and the swing. Polling averages are as published (all-voter margins); the small definitional mismatch is itself a component of historical 'polling error' as experienced by this model.
meta.sign_note: All margins are D-positive: +8.7 means D ahead by 8.7 points. error_points = final_average_d_margin - actual_d_margin (positive = polls overstated Democrats).
